request.idea: Maya and Leo discover a mysterious pathway behind a waterfall that leads them into a hidden world.

bible.userIdea: Maya and Leo discover a mysterious pathway behind a waterfall that leads them into a hidden world.

bible.premise: When maya follows a dry leaf, she and Leo discover a mysterious opening behind falling water. Its pathway leads into a hidden world where sunlight lifts rain toward the waterfall entrance.
bible.hook: A leaf slips through falling water without getting wet, revealing a gap in the curtain.
bible.goal: Reach the entrance before the last sunlight leaves the rising rain.
bible.centralProblem: The stones connecting the lake to the entrance rise out of reach, removing the children's route home.
bible.stakes: Without another way up, Maya and Leo will spend the night stranded below the entrance.
emotionalArc: Maya follows an unexpected opening while Leo checks their footing.
Their exploration stops when the route home rises away.
A failed launch makes them combine testing with daring.
They return with a new habit of looking together.
bible.motif: Water traveling upward; leaves becoming boats.
